tools.description: Apply an effect to a layer and optionally set its parameters in one undoable call. `effect` is an id (`ec.blur.gaussian`) or After Effects name (`Gaussian Blur`; see list_effects); `values` maps parameter ids to values, e.g. {"blurriness": 12}. tools.description: Add keyframes to a property (turns the stopwatch on): one with `time` (+ optional `value`, default the current value) or many with `keys: [{time, value}]`, then optionally set their `interpolation`: linear, bezier, hold, easyEase, easyEaseIn, easyEaseOut. Example: {"layer":1,"path":"transform/position","keys":[{"time":0,"value":[0,540]},{"time":2,"value":[1920,540]}],"interpolation":"easyEase"}.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

value.description: Number for 1-D properties (50), array for vectors ([960,540]), "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a] (0-1) for colours, bool for checkboxes, string for text/menus.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

tools.description: Run several engine commands in one call as ONE undo step (engine.batch). tools.description: Read one property: type, value at `time` (comp seconds; default the current time), whether it is animated, its keyframes (time, value, in/out interpolation) and expression. Popup (enum) properties add `options`: [{value, label}], the values set_property takes.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

tools.name: get_property

tools.description: Where things stand: the editor state (active comp, current time, selected layers/keys/items, open comps, tool, work area) plus what this build can do (`app`: version, command and effect counts, GPU effects, import/export formats, After Effects parity summary). Cheap; call it to re-orient after a series of edits.
tools.name: get_state

tools.description: The branching undo history (History panel): without arguments lists every state {index, id, label, parent, depth (0 = working line, >0 = branch), current, future}; undoing and then editing keeps the undone states as a branch. With `goto` (an index or id from the listing) jumps to that state, on any branch, without losing the others.

goto.description: State index or id to jump to (edit.history.goto).

tools.name: history

tools.description: List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, `params` doc (e.g. `{name?, width?, height?, frameRate?, duration? (s)}`) and whether it can run now (`why` if not). Every menu item, shortcut and panel gesture maps to one of these ids; run them with execute_command. Narrow with `filter` (e.g. `layer.new`, `keys`, `effect`); `compact: true` lists only ids and labels.

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

schemas.description: Also return each command's parameter JSON Schema (`schema`).

tools.name: list_commands

tools.description: The effect registry: id, After Effects name, category, GPU and 32-bpc support. Narrow with `filter` (id, name or category text); `compact: true` lists only ids, names and categories. Apply with add_effect.

filter.description: Only effects whose id, name or category contains this text.

tools.name: list_effects

tools.description: The font families text layers can use, bundled and installed on this machine: family, styles, origin (bundled / system / user), whether it is a variable font and the name in the font's own language. Narrow with `query` and `variable`; `rescan` picks up fonts installed since launch. Set one with execute_command `layer.setText {"layer", "font", "style"}`.

query.description: Only families whose name (English or own-language) contains this text.

rescan.description: Look for fonts installed since launch first.

variable.description: Only variable fonts (families with variation axes).

tools.name: list_fonts

tools.description: Open a project: `path` to an .ecproj file, `demo: true` for the built-in demo project, or `new: true` for an empty project. Returns the project overview.
tools.name: open_project

tools.description: Redo `steps` undone edits (default 1).
tools.name: redo

tools.description: Render a composition frame (default: the active comp at the current time) and return it as a PNG image, longest side `max_side` (default 960, 0 = full size). `path` also writes the PNG to disk; `inline: false` returns only the metadata. Use it to check your work.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

inline.description: Include the image in the reply (default true).

max_side.description: Longest side in pixels (default 960; 0 = full comp size).

time.description: Comp time in seconds (default: current time).

transparent.description: Keep the frame's alpha (RGBA PNG, as an RGB + Alpha render writes it) instead of compositing over the comp's background colour.

tools.name: render_frame

tools.description: Render a composition frame (default: the active comp at the current time) and return it as a PNG image, longest side `max_side` (default 960, 0 = full size). Use it to check your work.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

max_side.description: Longest side in pixels (default 960; 0 = full comp size).

time.description: Comp time in seconds (default: current time).

transparent.description: Keep the frame's alpha (RGBA PNG, as an RGB + Alpha render writes it) instead of compositing over the comp's background colour.

tools.name: render_preview

tools.description: Run JavaScript with an After Effects-style scripting object model (app, app.project, items.addComp, comp.layers.addSolid/addText/addShape/addNull/addCamera/addLight, layer.property("ADBE Transform Group").property("ADBE Position").setValueAtTime(t, v), Effects.addProperty("ADBE Gaussian Blur 2"), expressions, markers, renderQueue…). Every edit is an undoable engine command; app.beginUndoGroup/endUndoGroup make one undo step. Returns {ok, result (last expression value), output (writeLn/$.writeln/alert text), error: {message, line, column} | null}. File access is limited to the project folder unless the user allows scripts to write files.

code.description: JavaScript source, e.g. `var c = app.project.items.addComp("Main", 1920, 1080, 1, 5, 30); c.layers.addText("Hi"); c.numLayers`.

name.description: Script name used in error messages (default `script`).

tools.name: run_script

tools.description: Save the project to its current file, or to `path` (Save As, .ecproj).
tools.name: save_project

tools.description: Screenshot of the live app window, or one panel (`Composition`, `Timeline`, `EffectControls`, `Project`, ...) or element id, as PNG (longest side `max_side`, default 1600). Use it to check what the UI looks like after an action.

id.description: Element id (from ui_elements) to crop to.

path.description: Keep the full-size PNG at this path.

tools.name: screenshot

tools.description: Drive ScriptUI windows that scripts opened (dialogs, palettes, dockable panels). action `list` (default): open windows; `get`: a window's control tree (type, name, text, value, checked, items, selection, bounds); `click`: press a button / toggle a checkbox / pick a radio button; `set`: type text, move a slider, pick a list item (index or text); `close`: close a window (`result` for a dialog's show(), default 2 = Cancel). Controls by id, "#id", properties.name or text. A dialog's script resumes when the dialog closes.

result.description: For `close`: what the dialog's show() returns.

value.description: For `set`: text, number, bool, item index or item text.

window.description: Window id or title (optional when one is open).

tools.name: script_ui

tools.description: Set a property. Without `time`: sets the static value (or a key at the current time if already animated). With `time`: adds/replaces a keyframe there, turning the stopwatch on. `expression` sets an After Effects-style JS expression ("" removes it). Returns the property as get_property does. Examples: {"layer":3,"path":"transform/opacity","value":50}; {"layer":"Title","path":"transform/position","value":[200,540],"time":0}; {"layer":3,"path":"transform/rotation","expression":"time*90"}.

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

expression.description: Expression text; empty string removes the expression.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

path.description: Property path from get_layer: match ids joined by `/`, `#n` for the nth child, or `@uid`. E.g. `transform/position`, `transform/opacity`, `transform/scale`, `transform/rotation`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `masks/#1/feather`, `@57`.

time.description: Keyframe time in seconds (layer time; equals comp time unless the layer is offset/stretched).

timeBase.description: What `time` counts: layer time (the default) or comp time, as the Timeline shows it.

value.description: Number for 1-D properties (50), array for vectors ([960,540]), "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a] (0-1) for colours, bool for checkboxes, string for text/menus.

tools.name: set_property

tools.description: Click an element by `id` (from ui_elements) or at `x`,`y` (points). `button`: left|right|middle, `count`: 2 for double-click, `modifiers`: {shift, alt, command, ctrl}.
tools.name: ui_click

tools.description: Press-move-release from `from` to `to`; each is {"id": element} (add fx/fy 0-1 for a spot inside it) or {"x","y"}. Moves layers in the viewer, drags layer bars/keyframes/the CTI (`timeline.cti`), scrubs values, draws shapes with a shape tool.
tools.name: ui_drag

tools.description: Interactive elements drawn in the last frame: id, label, rect [x,y,w,h] in points. Stable ids such as `tools.Selection`, `panel.Timeline`, `panel.tab.EffectControls`, `project.item.<id>`, `viewer.comp`, `timeline.layer.<id>.bar`, `timeline.prop.<uid>.stopwatch`, `timeline.cti`, `effects.item.<name>`. Filter with `prefix`.

prefix.description: Only ids starting with this, e.g. `tools.`, `timeline.layer.`.

tools.name: ui_elements

tools.description: UI state: window size, tool, workspace, panels, viewer and timeline view state, playback, active comp, selection, open dialog, render time.
tools.name: ui_inspect

tools.description: Press a key or shortcut: `Space` (play), `F9` (Easy Ease), `Cmd+Z`, `Cmd+N`, `PageDown`, `Escape`, `Enter` (`Cmd` = Ctrl off macOS).
tools.name: ui_key

tools.description: Set UI state directly: tool, workspace, theme (dark|darker|light), focused panel, viewer {zoom, res, pan, grid, rulers, safeMargins, transparencyGrid}, timeline {pps, start, graphEditor, showModes, openLayers, openGroups}, menuBar, home.
tools.name: ui_set

tools.description: Type text into the focused field (text layer editing, search boxes, value fields).
tools.name: ui_type

tools.description: Undo the last `steps` edits (default 1). Returns the remaining undo stack.
tools.name: undo
